description.zh: V系列边缘一体机对应的设备名称。在边缘计算控制台V系列边缘一体机的**主机详情**页面**基本信息**页签，找到**视频网关**信息，获取**DeviceName**值。
description.en: The name of the device corresponding to the V series edge all-in-one device. On the **Host Details** page of the V series edge all-in-one device in the Edge Computing console, click the **Basic Information** tab, find the **Video Gateway** section, and obtain the **DeviceName** value.

description.zh:
实例ID。

您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。

> 如果公共实例没有ID值，请参见[如何获取实例ID](~~267533~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID.

You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID. Otherwise, the call fails.

> If no ID value is available for the public instance, see [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).

description.zh: V系列边缘一体机对应的设备所属产品唯一标识。在边缘计算控制台V系列边缘一体机的**主机详情**页面**基本信息**页签，找到**视频网关**信息，获取**ProductKey**值。
description.en: The unique identifier of the product to which the device corresponding to the V series edge all-in-one device belongs. On the **Host Details** page of the V series edge all-in-one device in the Edge Computing console, click the **Basic Information** tab, find the **Video Gateway** section, and obtain the **ProductKey** value.

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单个阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为100。
    > RAM用户共享阿里云账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Limits
The maximum number of queries per second (QPS) for a single Alibaba Cloud account to call this API operation is 100.
    > RAM users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
